Freshman All-American (2005) }} '''D.J. White''' is an American basketball player. His primary position is the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] but he also plays at [[Center (basketball)|center]]. He is currently a senior at [[Indiana University]] where he plays for the [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball]] team. White is from [[Tuscaloosa, Alabama]] and attended high school at [[Hillcrest High School (Tuscaloosa, Alabama)|Hillcrest High School]]. ==College career== During his freshman season White led all freshman in the Big Ten Conference in scoring.{{cite web | url = http://iuhoosiers.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/white_dj00.html | title = D.J. White | publisher = IUHoosiers.com | date = 2007-11-01 | accessdate = 2008-02-10}} He was named by [[Rivals.com]] as a Freshman All-American. He was also selected as the Big Ten Freshman of the Year.
